ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited has allotted an additional 1,277,155 equity shares to its promoter, Affle Holdings Pte. Ltd., through warrant conversion at Rs. 1,487 per share, significantly boosting its paid-up share capital. This move is part of a larger preferential allotment that has so far generated over Rs. 6.115 billion in capital for the company, while also implying ongoing dilution for existing shareholders due to these structured conversions to the promoter entity.
